learning.title: Restart a compose service with the complete first-start environment
learning.trigger: A drill or proof stops and starts the server or Inngest of an ephemeral-port stack.
learning.mistake: infra/compose.yaml passes BAKERY_BUDGET_* and several other variables through bare, so a recreate with only the ports and the auth secret renders them null and the server comes back with no budget policy: every funded step after the restart fails. A container id captured at start is also stale after the first recreate, because the compose config hash differs between port 0 and the resolved port.
learning.rule: Write the whole first-start compose environment, with the resolved ports and the web-origin public URL, to one file and load it verbatim for every later compose call. Stop then up -d --no-deps --wait, diff the published port before and after, and resolve the container fresh with compose ps -q at check time. Never restart a service on ephemeral ports with compose restart.

verification.requirement: The M1 proof logs restartServer and restartInngest with the port unchanged; tests/unit/m1-stack-env_test.ts rejects a stack.env missing a required key.
